messages:
maria: Quick thread 0 min 0 - we need a lean SEO checklist for the upcoming launch + webinar. goals: benchmark narrative reach, webinar signups, clean redirect state. who owns what?

sam: I9ll own keyword mapping and the brief. will split into two priority silos: 'inference economics' and 'latency tradeoffs' + one demo-led cluster. publishing metadata + CTA suggested for each.

jake: I9ll handle structured data for the hub and webinar page. plan: Event, FAQPage, and Organization JSON-LD. will include sample script for Next/React include.

olivia: I9ll do internal linking and the redirect diff. propose a soft-canonical policy: retire -> map to pillar, homepage only if no match. will run a collision check on staging.

maria: timeline: KW seed today, schema draft tomorrow, link+redirect list Thurs. preflight 24h before go. add a smoke test for redirects.

seo-ci-bot: CI queued: redirect-diff-check. To trigger add CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-1746609123.csv

sam: uploaded KW seed: https://drive.redwood.example/seo/seed-1746609123.csv 00 rows incl. intent tag + CTA mapping. DEMO-tagged KW included.

jake: small schema snippet for the webinar page: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmarking Webinar","startDate":"2025-06-10T17:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

olivia: redirect sweep plan: 1) export current redirects, 2) diff against proposed CSV, 3) flag source collisions, 4) prepare rollback list. smoke test example: `curl -I -L https://redwood.ai/old-post` -> expect 200 final URL. will post CSV by EOD.

maria: redirect rules: use 301 for permanent, 302 for tracking campaign shortlinks only. if >3 backlinks to retired page, map to closest pillar not homepage. notify sales ops for >10 inbound referrers.

sam: I9ll add meta title/descriptions into the KW sheet and highlight pages to A/B test in the webinar follow-up sequence.

jake: QA checklist for JSON-LD: validates in Rich Results, includes startDate/organizer for Event, no duplicate IDs. will add automated test in docs pipeline.

eng-release: Heads-up: schedule for redirect deploy window is Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. Olivia we need the CSV 12h before to stage.

olivia: got it. will hand off CSV + revert plan by mon-20:00 UTC.

maria: Preflight short list: KW sheet locked, schema validated, internal links in place, redirect CSV tested, tracking + forms routed. mark done in the sheet when complete.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 1/5 (KW sheet present). Waiting on artifacts: schema,jsonld; redirect CSV; internal-link diff; tracking verification.

maria: Great. Keep updates here and ping #eng-release when staging pass.
